description: This file implements a translation utility in Go, defining the PiTranslator struct and its methods for translating text, handling retries, masking placeholders, and interacting with an external docsPiClient. It also manages prompt execution and error handling for translation requests.

classes.name: PiTranslator
classes.description: A struct for handling translation via an external API client, managing retries, placeholders, and masking.

methods.name: NewPiTranslator
methods.description: Creates a new PiTranslator instance with specified source and target languages, glossary, and thinking level.

methods.name: PiTranslator.Translate
methods.description: Translates given text from source to target language with masking.

methods.name: PiTranslator.TranslateRaw
methods.description: Translates text from source to target language without masking.

methods.name: PiTranslator.translate
methods.description: Internal method that performs the translation with retries, handling prefix and suffix in the text.

methods.name: PiTranslator.translateWithRetry
methods.description: Handles retry logic for translation attempts.

methods.name: PiTranslator.translateMasked
methods.description: Performs masked translation, managing placeholders and unmasking afterward.

methods.name: PiTranslator.translateRaw
methods.description: Performs raw translation without masking or placeholder management.

methods.name: PiTranslator.Close
methods.description: Closes the client connection if open.
